name: inochi2d-web-workspace
description: Reproducible Inochi2D WebGL2 runtime and Hexo widget workspace

scripts.build: npm run fixtures && npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace inochi2d-web && npm run build --workspace hexo-inox2d-widget && npm run build --workspace @inochi2d-web/vanilla-example && npm run build --workspace @inochi2d-web/hexo-example
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.validate: npm run check:rust && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run pack:check
